name: Krom Stoutarm
summary: In Ironforge, Krom Stoutarm turns to the darker arts in the Hall of Explorers. A dwarven scholar and warlock, he studies arcane texts and demonic rites in the library. He guides Alliance warlocks seeking esoteric knowledge across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.

sections.title: A Darker Corner of the Hall
sections.body: Krom Stoutarm pursues occult lore in the Hall of Explorers. While dwarven archaeologists there study titan artifacts with picks and shovels, Krom turns to massive tomes and the rites for binding demons. His work gives a warlock’s craft a place in Ironforge’s mountain halls, though many distrust those arts.

sections.title: The Tome of the Cabal
sections.body: Alliance warlocks seeking to bind powerful demons such as the felhunter turn to Krom Stoutarm. He knows of occult volumes scattered across distant lands. He sends summoners to recover torn pages and fragments of the infamous Tome of the Cabal, including from the centaur of Thousand Needles.

faq.q: Where can I find Krom Stoutarm?
faq.answer: You can find Krom Stoutarm in the Library wing of the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge.

faq.q: What role does Krom Stoutarm play for players?
faq.answer: Krom guides Alliance warlocks through demonic rites, including the recovery of the Tome of the Cabal.

faq.q: Is Krom Stoutarm related to other Stoutarms?
faq.answer: Several dwarves share the Stoutarm surname, but no family relationship between Krom and the others is confirmed.

faq.q: Why is a warlock permitted inside the Hall of Explorers?
aliases: why is krom in hall of explorers
faq.answer: Krom is a dwarf of Ironforge who once worked as a digger at the Uldaman excavation. Now an itinerant warlock, he gathers ancient texts in the library, and no one is known to have turned him away.

faq.q: Why is Krom connected to the Barrens?
faq.answer: Krom’s search for the Tome of the Cabal ends in the Barrens. Warlocks recover its torn halves from the centaur of Thousand Needles and from a lost shipment off the coast west of Southshore. Krom then sends the rebuilt tome to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.
Krom is a scholarly contact rather than a class trainer. He guides warlocks through particular rites of passage instead of teaching everyday grimoires.

angles.text: As an Alliance warlock, you consult Krom while pursuing dark bindings, including the dangerous work of assembling the Tome of the Cabal.
As a dwarf, you see Krom’s place among the Hall of Explorers’ revered shelves as a rare exception, since dwarves usually reject the fell arts.
As an Alliance practitioner, you can find an intellectual refuge with Krom inside Ironforge’s mountain stronghold.
